verdict.rationale: Wise documents a Delivery Estimate API that returns the expected arrival time of a transfer in the recipient's bank account [wise-docs-22]. A comparison API also returns speed information [wise-docs-19], and marketing claims most transfers arrive in under 20 seconds [wise-docs-7]. That covers the core need for a delivery estimate, but the evidence does not tie it to ACH or wire rails or confirm it is shown before the transfer is confirmed. missing for 10: explicit ACH/wire-specific delivery estimates, evidence the estimate appears in the pre-confirmation step (UI or quote stage), detail on how precise the estimate is, independent or hands-on corroboration.
